# Summer camp: meals brief

Hollin Wood campsite, Friday 11 July to Sunday 13 July. 22 Scouts (ages 10 to 14) and 4 leaders.

## What we know

- Two Scouts need special food. Ravi has a severe nut allergy and carries an auto-injector. Freya is coeliac and cannot eat gluten.
- The kitchen tent has two gas rings and one large camp oven. There is no fridge; the site rents out a cool box trailer.
- The only tap is a standpipe 60 m from the kitchen tent.
- The treasurer has set the food budget at £7 per person per day.
- Meals to cover: Friday supper, all of Saturday, Sunday breakfast and a packed lunch.
- Scouts help cook, in patrols. None of the leaders has cooked for a group this size before.
